entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [Blazor] Analyzer should check that Element reference instances are only ever read within OnAfterRenderAsync #63247
    Backlog
  • [Blazor] Implement property analyzer also for [PersistentState] #63235
  • OpenApiSchema.AnyOf will reuse same key for schema #63233

Closed

  • Validation support in Minimal APIs should be AOT compatible #61339
    10.0-rc1
  • ASPNETCORE_HOSTINGSTARTUPASSEMBLIES not working for Blazor wasm development server #63130
  • Blazor MSAL RedirectToLogin.razor out of date #63199
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `aspnetcore/release/9.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #63118
  • Request Browser-Testing Dependencies Update #63028
  • [dotnet.js] is not incremental #63207
    10.0-rc1

PullRequests

Created

  • Docs: Add instructions for viewing build-time OpenAPI logs with Terminal Logger #63251
    area-commandlinetools, community-contribution
  • [release/8.0] Make duplicate deb/rpm packages so we can sign them with the new PMC key #63250
    8.0.x
  • [9.0] Make duplicate deb/rpm packages so we can sign them with the new PMC key #63249
    tell-mode, 9.0.x
  • [Blazor] Add analyzer to check ElementReference usage is only in OnAfterRenderAsync #63248
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • Add analyzer and codefixer for WebHost.CreateDefaultBuilder to Host.CreateDefaultBuilder.ConfigureWebHostDefaults #63246
    area-minimal
  • Improve antiforgery error message for unauthenticated users with authenticated tokens #63241
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • [Blazor] Always treat "preloads" as new elements when doing enhanced navigation #63239
    area-blazor, 10.0-rc1
  • Fix IBrowserFile Name property to return FileName instead of form field name #63238
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • [Blazor] Implement property analyzer for [PersistentState] attribute #63236
    Attention: Shared Code Modified

Merged

  • [main] Use PipeReader JsonSerializer overloads #62914
    10.0-rc1
  • Don't reference System.ValueTuple on netstandard2.0 #63240
    needs-area-label, 10.0-rc1
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #63243
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops, 10.0-rc1

Updated

  • [WIP] Update to wix5 #62885
    area-infrastructure
  • Fix FromKeyedServicesAttribute and FromServicesAttribute to support derived types across all generators #63114
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • Add [Obsolete] attribute to WebHost class and IWebHost interface with proper diagnostic codes, convert sample apps to HostBuilder pattern #63024
  • 59462 OIDC par failure #61947
    area-auth, community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun
  • Send Keep-Alive Ping Immediately When Previous Ping Is Overdue #63195
    area-signalr, community-contribution
  • [release/9.0] [OpenAPI] Use invariant culture for TextWriter #62239
    Servicing-approved, community-contribution, feature-openapi, area-minimal, 9.0.10

  • Enable `SubmitButtonFormactionAttributeOverridesEnhancedFormAction` #63146
    area-blazor, pending-ci-rerun, 10.0-rc1
  • [Blazor] Generate better error message(s) when we encounter an unknown RenderTreeFrameType #63230

  • Add support for .slnx file exclusion in BaselineTest #62767
